title: Bridge and Orchard
author: Zephyrine Blackwood
blurb: Lior Nystrom, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
